result.summary: Found 1 issue: a minor vertical alignment inconsistency in the 'Fastest near you' carousel where card images and their text blocks are not aligned to a common baseline, creating a ragged layout. Horizontally clipped carousel items and the bottom-cut card are treated as intended features and not reported.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' row, the three cards have images of differing heights and vertical offsets (the middle 'Smash Bros Burgers' image sits lower and is taller than the 'Green Bowl Poké' image), so the restaurant names and delivery-fee lines do not align horizontally across cards. This produces a ragged, unpolished grid where titles appear at different vertical positions.
issues.suggestion: Give all carousel cards a fixed image height and top-align both the image and the text block within each card so that titles and delivery-fee lines sit on a consistent baseline across the row.
